articleTitle: Why Your Front Splits Routine Needs More Than Hamstring Work
imageHeadline: Your splits routine is missing half the work
imageSubtext: Hip flexors matter as much as hamstrings—here's how to train both
pinTitle: Why Front Splits Need Hip Flexor Stretching (Not Just Hamstring Work)
pinDescription: Low lunges and forward folds aren't enough. A front split requires flexibility from both sides of your hip at once—hamstring length in the front leg and hip flexor length in the back. Learn how to structure your routine with the right stretches, volume, and sequencing for real progress.

items.label: Warm up with 5-10 minutes of light movement
Alternate hamstring and hip flexor stretches
Aim for 2-4 minutes per muscle group
End in a supported split position
